narrative.northStar: Reference / Workspace: one quiet Oracle workbench
narrative.overview: A minimal, keyboard-operated terminal workspace with a fixed charcoal and Black Ember gold RGB palette. A compact sidebar holds connections, schema objects and open files; one shared frame holds document tabs, SQL editor and gridded results. The user approved this replacement direction after reviewing static proposals and the gold accent in a real-TUI preview. Terminal cells determine geometry and the terminal owns the font. No browser styling, desktop chrome or animation is part of the interface.
keyCharacteristics: One sidebar and one shared editor/results frame on wide terminals.
Gold active tabs and focused sidebar rows, warm readable text, and explicit result-grid rules.
Adaptive single-panel presentation and compact, scrolling connection forms.
Persistent session, execution and transaction feedback.

rules.name: The Focus Rule
rules.body: The active document tab uses gold fill with dark text. Focused Connections and Explorer selections, plus the active file while SQL Editor has focus, use the same gold fill; inactive selections and result rows stay tonal. Section headings follow focus. Row and column rules plus textual position keep dense result navigation legible without color alone.

dos: Do preserve terminal-cell geometry and terminal-owned monospace typography.
Do keep the active tab and focused work area recognizable while keeping keyboard hints contextual.
Do keep the four panels reachable when the terminal shows only one at a time.
Do pair meaningful color with labels, position or state markers.
Do keep the selected form field visible and passwords masked.
donts: Don't introduce browser components, CSS dimensions or raster assets into this native interface.
Don't reintroduce separate boxed cards for every workbench section.
Don't hide execution errors or transaction state behind color alone.
Don't add invented font scales, rounded corners, shadows or motion tokens.
